summary: Full re-embed run 3 hung 2h: smoke run was a no-op (both batches already committed from run 1/2), so model load + encode path never validated; full run stalled after 'main: rows' with flat 44.5% CPU, zero EBS reads, no commit. Log uploader also dead due to mount-order bug (mkdir before mount hid the log file).
root_cause: Smoke validated nothing because checkpoint from earlier runs made it skip both batches. The real embed path (model load + first 262K batch) then hung on first use. Secondary: log uploader wrote to a /data path hidden by the late mount, so no S3-side logs were available for monitoring.
